recommendation: Keep this fix as-is. It completes FHIR-40462 without adding a new value set or broadening unrelated MedicationRequest content; any MedicationStatement binding harmonization should be handled separately because FHIR-40787 only requested Procedure references.
issue_request: FHIR-40462 was an Applied/Persuasive Pharmacy request to update MedicationRequest reason so Procedure could be represented as a coded reason and as a referenced reason.
initial_application: Commit 0eef1b615326487c7e0f16d455c272937cf98ae6 added Procedure to MedicationRequest.reason targetProfile, covering the reference half after reasonCode and reasonReference were merged into CodeableReference, but the binding still pointed at ValueSet/condition-code.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini. The linked Zulip thread records the motivating Procedure-as-reason use case, Pharmacy minutes record FHIR-40462 discussed and approved, and the existing procedure-reason value set includes both SNOMED clinical-finding and procedure hierarchies. Related FHIR-40787 concerns the parallel MedicationStatement Procedure reference request and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Changed source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml so MedicationRequest.reason binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/procedure-reason instead of http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/condition-code. The existing Procedure targetProfile was left intact.
source_changes: source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml: changed MedicationRequest.reason example binding from ValueSet/condition-code to ValueSet/procedure-reason.

related_jiras.note: Applied MedicationStatement issue that followed FHIR-40462 for Procedure reason references; it is already represented on the combined branch and was not republished.
